paraphrase: Pre-market research, testing and development of AI is outside the Regulation, but testing in real world conditions is not covered by that exclusion.
notes: Scope rule; indirectly brings real world testing under the Regulation.

paraphrase: Defines conformity assessment as the process of demonstrating whether the Chapter III Section 2 requirements for a high-risk system are met.
notes: Definition only.

paraphrase: Defines testing data as data giving an independent evaluation of the trained system to confirm expected performance, distinct from validation data used for tuning.
notes: Definition; summary of fetch, not verbatim.

paraphrase: Defines testing in real-world conditions as temporary testing for intended purpose outside a laboratory, governed by a real-world testing plan.
what_is_tested: intended purpose performance in real conditions
notes: Definition; operative rules are in later articles (Art. 60 and 61), which could not be read.

paraphrase: Processing of special category personal data for bias detection and correction is allowed only where other data cannot achieve it.
notes: Provision appears in this consolidated version; evaluation force is weak, it is a data permission.

paraphrase: Use of real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement requires a completed fundamental rights impact assessment under Art. 27 first.
notes: Assessment is a precondition of use; testing content not specified here.

paraphrase: A provider who concludes an Annex III system is not high-risk must document that assessment before placing it on the market.
notes: Self-assessment of risk; not clearly testing evidence.

paraphrase: Providers may integrate the necessary testing and reporting processes into existing sectoral documentation and procedures.
notes: Integration permission for products under Annex I law.

paraphrase: High-risk systems must be tested to identify the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures.
notes: Part of risk management system.

paraphrase: Testing must ensure the system performs consistently for its intended purpose and complies with Section 2 requirements.
notes: Summary of fetch.

paraphrase: Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Art. 60.
notes: Permissive wording.

paraphrase: Testing must use prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds suited to the intended purpose, in any event before placing on the market or putting into service.
notes: Key pre-deployment testing requirement.

paraphrase: High-risk systems using model training must be developed on training, validation and testing data sets meeting the quality criteria.
notes: Data quality rather than evaluation itself.

paraphrase: Data governance practices must include examination of data for biases likely to harm health, safety or rights.
notes: Examination of data, not model.

paraphrase: For high-risk systems not using training techniques, the data set rules apply to testing data sets only.
notes: Shows testing data is required even without training.

paraphrase: Instructions for use must state the accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity levels against which the system was tested and validated.
notes: Documentation duty that presupposes testing.

paraphrase: High-risk systems must reach an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity and perform consistently through their lifecycle.
notes: Performance requirement, evaluation implied not stated.

paraphrase: Commission is to encourage development of benchmarks and measurement methodologies for accuracy and robustness, with stakeholders.
notes: Actor is the Commission, not the provider.

paraphrase: Accuracy levels and relevant accuracy metrics must be declared in the instructions of use.
notes: Declaration implies measurement.

paraphrase: Systems must resist unauthorised attempts to alter use, outputs or performance, including data poisoning and adversarial examples or model evasion.
notes: Requirement of resilience; testing method not specified.

paraphrase: Providers must ensure the system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure under Art. 43 before market placement or service.
notes: Procedure content is in Art. 43, which could not be read.

paraphrase: Quality management system must include a compliance strategy covering conformity assessment procedures.
notes: Governance, included for completeness.

paraphrase: Quality management system must include examination, test and validation procedures carried out before, during and after development, with their frequency.
notes: Covers pre-deployment testing.

paraphrase: Importers must verify before market placement that the provider carried out the conformity assessment procedure.
notes: Check of evidence, not testing itself.

paraphrase: Distributors must verify the CE marking, declaration of conformity and instructions before making a system available.
notes: Check of evidence.

paraphrase: Initial provider of a system must inform new providers of known limitations and failure modes when a system is substantially modified.
notes: Weak; information handover.

paraphrase: Initial provider must give new providers targeted technical access, including for testing and validation.
notes: Value chain provision.

paraphrase: Certain deployers (public bodies, public service providers and Annex III credit and insurance users) must assess fundamental rights impact before first use of a high-risk system.
notes: Six listed elements; no testing method required.

paraphrase: Deployers must notify the market surveillance authority of the fundamental rights impact assessment results.
notes: Reporting of assessment.

paraphrase: Notified bodies must verify conformity of high-risk systems under the conformity assessment procedures of Art. 43.
notes: Binds the notified body; procedure in Art. 43 not read.
